commands: TOKEN=$(docker exec slife-be sh -c 'curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/auth/login -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"email\":\"slife.hola@gmail.com\",\"password\":\"Admin@123\"}"' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["accessToken"])' 2>/dev/null); echo "Token len: ${#TOKEN}"; dd if=/dev/urandom bs=1024 count=1 2>/dev/null | base64 > /tmp/test.png; docker exec slife-be sh -c "curl -v -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/community/posts -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'payload=@-;type=application/json' -F 'images=@/tmp/test.png;type=image/png;filename=test.png' <<< '{\"description\":\"direct multipart test\"}' 2>&1" || echo DIRECT_TEST_FAILED
